context.content:
I mentioned Maestro since that is a well known name, and because I know that is generally accepted in NL. In some countries you also have 'debit credit cards' (sometimes also known as prepaid credit cards), and those are usually not accepted.

And I know a lot of foreigners struggle with this, since it seems that the Netherlands is an exception in this. A good example is that when you want to buy a train ticket, they usually don't accept creditcards (or at least, that was the case a few years ago).
